spans.s:
वोर m. (-रः) A sort of pulse, (Dolichos catjang.) E. Apparently not a
Sanskrit word, though occurring in regular compounds.
वोरक m. (-कः) A scribe, a writer. E. See वोलक ।
वोरट m. (-टः) A sort of jasmine. “कुन्दपुष्पे ।”

वोरपट्टी f. (-ट्टी) A sort of mat or mattress for sleeping on.
 E. वोर
Dolichos catjang, पट्टी coarse cloth; perhaps made of the straw.
वोरव m. (-वः) A kind of rice, which is cut in March or April. “वोरोधान्”.
वोरुखान m. (-नः) A horse, described as of a white and red colour.
